result.summary: The page is generally laid out correctly, but the top-right action button appears visually incomplete: it shows a notification dot without a visible underlying icon.

issues.description: The circular action button in the top-right header is an empty light-gray circle with only a red notification badge. Its intended icon (such as cart, profile, or notifications) is missing or not visible.
issues.suggestion: Restore the button icon and ensure it has sufficient contrast against the circular background; keep the red badge positioned over the visible icon.
